answer: Require each identity to earn standing through a slow, verifiable work history before it can vote or receive rewards: a newcomer must complete a sequence of useful, peer-checked tasks over several days, and its record is tied to one refundable bond. Like boats that must cross a lagoon one at a time rather than flooding the harbor, identities cannot be mass-produced overnight. A raven that tries to wander in with a thousand fresh faces would have to fund a thousand bonds and wait out a thousand slow histories, while one honest agent pays that cost only once.
